Secondary endpoints (ACR50, ACR70) also showed success. EULAR response rates and SF-36 scores also favored rituximab, though the EULAR differences were modest. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: The trial enrolled RA patients on background methotrexate being retreated after an initial rituximab course. ACR50 and ACR70 responses were also positive, suggesting a dose-response gradient in clinical benefit. The population was well-defined (functional class III, second-line, moderate severity). 5. The trial was adequately powered with 559 participants and 48-week duration appropriate for RA retreatment assessment. Overall, this is a successful trial demonstrating rituximab retreatment efficacy in RA.
